about: PROGNOSE.ETS and companions against German Excel 365 (D-124). Broad set: probe_excel_ets_broad.py, 48 series, 99 fits (with the season found, Saisonalitaet 0, Datenvervollstaendigung 0, Aggregation 2-7), each with STAT 1-8, the values at every time point and forecasts / confidence intervals 1-24 steps ahead; measured by packages/sheet-engine/test/ets-broad.test.ts. Old set: probe_excel_ets.py, 8 series, h = 1, 2, 3, 6, 12 (ets-excel.test.ts). Relative error against Excel's value (on the broad set at least 5 % of the series' largest value as the base).
recorded_exactly: error-correction form: l += b + alpha e, b += beta e, s += gamma e (Excel's own alpha, beta, gamma give Excel's end states to 1e-9)
start without a season: trend = slope of the least-squares line through all points, level so that the first one-step value is the first point (n >= 7)
the first one-step error is 0 with a season too

STAT 4-7 over a holdout of the last k points: k = n for n <= 10, else max(min(floor(0.4 n), 10), ceil(0.2 n)); SMAPE = mean 2|e|/(|y|+|f|); MASE = MAE / mean |y_i - y_(i-1)| over the points before the holdout
KONFINT = z * RMSE(all one-step errors) * sqrt(1 + sum_(j<h) (alpha + j beta + gamma [m divides j])^2)
values inside the timeline = level + h trend + season with h <= 0 (not the one-step values)
not_found: Excel's start of the season (centred moving average, per-cycle means and least squares of the start states all come within a few tenths of a unit, none exactly)

Excel's choice among the values: SSE of the one-step errors before the holdout plus the SSE of the forecasts over the holdout picks Excel's alpha in 34 of 41 fits without a season, but only 15 of 41 (alpha and gamma) with one
the start for series of 4 to 6 points
beta other than 0.001 (quad_n20: 0.249, two seasonal fits)

after.worst: gaps_m4 with Datenvervollstaendigung 0 (we find a season 8 where Excel finds none), quad_n20 (Excel's beta 0.249), dups_m6 with Aggregation 7 (season 5 against 2)

with_excels_own_parameters.note: the floor left by the start of the season and of series of 4-6 points

after.note: worse on 'short' (8 points with a season 3): Excel takes alpha 0.002, gamma 0.25, we take a larger alpha, so the interval grows faster
